At Astec, we design and build the infrastructure that connects the world, but it’s the connections with people that truly move us forward. Born from innovation and a passion for customer success, we unite as one company to simplify how you do business with us and to strengthen partnerships across the industries we serve. From concept to completion, our solutions are engineered to perform reliably today and be ready for whatever tomorrow brings.
Astec brings together 16 trusted brands, each with deep industry expertise, to deliver comprehensive solutions across the infrastructure, construction, and materials sectors.
Astec operates in 12 countries worldwide, providing global reach with local support to deliver consistent, high-quality solutions wherever customers do business.
With over 4,300 employees worldwide, Astec is powered by a skilled and dedicated team committed to innovation, quality, and customer success.

raw_blocks: Our Vision: To build industry changing solutions that create life-changing opportunities
Our People. Our Purpose. Our Story.

Driven by a legacy of innovation, Astec works behind the scenes, transforming challenges into progress and helping build the infrastructure that physically connects the world. But our commitment extends far beyond the equipment we manufacture; it lives in the expertise we share, the partnerships we foster, and the solutions we deliver. With over 4,000 employees and a global presence, we are united by a passion to help our customers succeed, simplify how they do business with us, and empower the people and communities we serve. At Astec, we are Built to Connect.
Innovative Solutions for Your Project
Your Industry. Our Solutions. Explore Now .
OUR BUSINESS LANDSCAPE AND MARKET PHILOSOPHY

At Astec, we design and build the infrastructure that connects the world, and it’s the connections with people that truly move us forward. Founded in 1972, we brought creative thinking and state-of-the-art technology to industries ready for innovation, backed by a corporate culture known for putting customer service first. Today, our market-leading brands serve a wide range of industries, providing equipment and solutions that are reliable, productive, and sustainable.

Our mission is simple: to design and build state-of-the-art equipment that enables our customers to deliver industry-leading results efficiently and profitably. We combine innovative products with world-class training, education, and support, helping our customers succeed at every stage of their projects.

For our customers , we strive to be the most innovative company in our industry, offering advanced, durable, and environmentally responsible solutions. From equipment to education, service, and support, we go beyond what our competition provides to ensure our customers thrive.

For our employees , we provide a safe and welcoming work environment where employees are empowered to suggest improvements across all areas of the business. Safety is our first core value, and we invest in training, personal protective equipment, and technology to advance our safety programs — always striving for zero harm.

For our shareholders , we aim to deliver continuous growth in shareholder value through long-term, stable increases in earnings. By expanding and enhancing the scope and profitability of our core business — through internal growth and strategic acquisitions — we strengthen our market position while preparing for the future.
